summary: KPG32D.EXE 1.00 traced in QEMU and run to 'Done Reading' against a simulated radio: 9600 8N2 via BIOS INT 14h, PROGRAM/06, 02 -> 8-byte identity checked back to front (P0359 + band + 0x81), S 03 <hi+AC> <lo> 80 -> X echo + 128 bytes + sum8, 06/06, E. NewChirp's TK-359 transport (9600 8N1, bare 02, R/W from 0xF000) was never what the CPS sends, which explains no identity response. SAMPLE.FDT is a TK-259 (VHF) codeplug
